title: No initial readings
symptom: Xdrip+ is stuck on 'collecting initial readings' after connecting to the miao miao transmitter, with no readings appearing. The issue persists after changing the Libre sensor, changing to a new miao miao 2, reinstalling xdrip+, and trying on a different phone.
fix: One user reported that activating airplane mode solved the problem, but this is not confirmed as the official resolution. The issue was later closed as resolved without specifying the exact fix.
evidence_quote: That happened to me quite often, and I was able to solve the problem several times activing airplane mode.
